title: Between Damocles and Hydra
coreMove: Sort a system by its response to volatility before deciding whether to shield it, test it, or leave it alone.
sourcePressure: This chapter installs the missing map: fragile is harmed by volatility, robust resists it, and antifragile gains from bounded stress.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating antifragile as a fancy synonym for resilient toughness.

sourceAnchors.name: Damocles
sourceAnchors.detail: appears safe and honored until the sword above him reveals one concentrated point of failure
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Damocles looks powerful until the room asks the only question that matters: what single thread can end this?

sourceAnchors.name: Hydra
sourceAnchors.detail: the positive image of a system that returns stronger after attack
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Hydra is the reminder that survival and gain are not the same response.

hook: opening by explaining Between Damocles and Hydra
counterintuition: Treating antifragile as a fancy synonym for resilient toughness.
tryThisNow: make a pros and cons list with no exposure map
